name: Global AI Hackathon
about: ![Geek Room AI Global Hackathon](https://hackcultureplatform.blob.core.windows.net/event-assets/hackathons/6ac5c8240037f69fb28e23ec/upload_1791482564850_3prquo.webp?cb=1) **Build the future of AI. From anywhere in the world.** Geek Room presents a **global, fully virtual AI-focused hackathon**, open to developers, students, researchers, and builders from **any country, background, and skill level**. Bring your ideas, experiment with **cutting-edge AI technologies**, solve real-world challenges, and build alongside a global community of innovators, all from wherever you are. With multiple **tracks, technologies, and challenges**, participants can choose what they want to build and how they want to build it. ### WHY PARTICIPATE? - **Global and open to everyone** across countries, backgrounds, and skill levels. - **AI-focused challenges** across multiple tracks and technologies. - Build using technologies from **leading industry partners**. - **100% virtual**, allowing you to participate from anywhere. - Compete for **prizes, recognition, and opportunities**. - Connect and collaborate with **builders from around the world**. - Showcase your project to **leading companies and the wider developer community**. **One idea. One team. One global stage.** **Organized by Geek Room with ❤️**

eligibility.details:
* **Open globally** to participants from any country.
* Open to students, developers, designers, founders, researchers, and *AI enthusiasts*.
* Participants can participate individually or in teams of **up to 4 members**.
* Teams may consist of members from different countries and *time zones*.
* No specific degree, educational background, or professional experience is required.
* Participants may use **AI tools, APIs, open-source models, and third-party technologies**, subject to their respective terms of use.

phases.name: Registration
phases.description: Register for the hackathon, explore the available themes, and get ready to build with the global AI community. **Complete your registration before the deadline to participate.**

phases.name: Team Formation & Preparation
phases.description: Find your teammates, connect with fellow builders, and prepare for the challenge ahead. Explore technologies, discuss ideas, and get your team ready **before the problem statements go live**.

phases.name: Problem Statements & Prototype Submission
phases.description: **Problem statements go live on 1 Nov**, and the **prototype submission window opens at the same time**. Choose your challenge, build your AI-powered solution, and submit your working prototype within the two-week building window.

faq.question: Can I participate individually?
faq.answer: Yes, you can participate individually or with a team of 4.

faq.question: Who can participate in the hackathon?
faq.answer: Students, engineers, developers, AI builders, working professionals, and anyone interested in building solutions can participate.

faq.question: When will the problem statements be released?
faq.answer: The official problem statements will go live on 1 Nov 2026. You can start preparing with your team before then, but the official challenges will be revealed on 1 Nov.

faq.question: Do I need to join Discord?
faq.answer: Yes. Joining the official Discord server is required for all participants. Discord will be used for important announcements, team communication, workshops, challenge updates, technical guidance, and hackathon support.

faq.question: Can I use existing code, libraries, or AI tools?
faq.answer: Yes. You can use existing libraries, frameworks, boilerplate, open-source software, APIs, and AI development tools. However, the core project should be substantially developed during the hackathon.

announcements.title: [IMP] Global AI Hackathon: Problem Statements & Prizes Announced!
announcements.description:
The problem statements for the Global AI Hackathon are officially out, check here: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7522343349710946304

We’re excited to have Bifrost as our Title Partner and Tavily as our Track Partner, bringing some exciting challenges for developers worldwide.

Here’s what’s up for grabs:

# Bifrost Track

* **$1,000 in cash prizes**
* Direct interview opportunities for winning teams
* Challenges around AI agents, benchmarking, security, and open-source development

# Tavily Track

* **$60,000 worth of credits for the top 3 teams**
* $8,000 in credits for participants building with Tavily
* Challenges around real-time information retrieval and AI-powered research

How does it work?

Every team must select one problem statement from each track. You can either build two separate projects or combine both challenges into one integrated solution.

With 1,400+ registrations from 40+ countries, we’re excited to see what developers build!

rules:
### 1. **Build During the Hackathon**

Projects should be substantially developed during the official hackathon period. Existing libraries, frameworks, boilerplate, and supporting infrastructure may be used, but the **core project** should be created during the hackathon.

### 2. **AI Usage**

Participants are encouraged to use **AI models, agents, APIs, vector databases, frameworks**, and other AI technologies. The use of AI tools should be clearly mentioned in the project submission where applicable.

### 3. **Discord & Official Communication**

All participants are **required to join the official [hackathon Discord server](https://discord.gg/WBvcRKg8t)**. Discord will be used for **team communication, important announcements, challenge updates, workshops, technical guidance, and hackathon-related support**.

Participants are responsible for checking the official Discord channels regularly so they do not miss important updates, deadlines, or announcements.

Participants are responsible for checking the official Discord channels regularly so they do not miss important updates, deadlines, or announcements.

### 4. **Team Size**

Teams can consist of **1–4 members**. Each participant can be part of only one team.

### 5. **Original Work**

All submissions must be original work or use components that participants have the legal right to use. *Plagiarism or unauthorized use of intellectual property* will result in disqualification.

### 6. **Third-Party Tools**

Participants may use third-party APIs, SDKs, datasets, open-source software, and developer tools, provided they comply with the applicable *licenses and terms of service*.

### 7. **Submission Requirements**

Each submission must include:
* A **working project or demo**
* Source code or repository
* Project description
* Explanation of the problem being solved
* Technologies and tools used
* **Explanation of how AI is used in the solution**
* Demo video, if required

**Build Resources:**  
Participants can explore the [Bifrost GitHub repository](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost) as a technical resource while building their projects.

### 8. **One Submission per Team**

Each team may submit **only one final project**.

### 9. **Responsible Development**

Projects must comply with applicable laws and platform policies. Projects involving *illegal activities, malicious software, fraud, harassment, or harmful content* may be disqualified.

### 10. **Judging Criteria**

Projects will be evaluated based on:
* **Innovation**
* Technical execution
* Problem and potential impact
* **Use of AI**
* User experience
* Scalability and potential

### 11. **Organizer’s Decision**

The organizers reserve the right to disqualify submissions that violate the **rules, eligibility requirements, or spirit of the hackathon**.
